name: Nicodim Gallery
about_text: Nicodim Gallery is a contemporary art gallery led by owner Mihai Nicodim, with spaces in Los Angeles, New York, and Bucharest. Its program centers on painting and sculpture by an international, cross-generational roster of artists, including figures from Zimbabwe, South Africa, Romania, Spain, and the United States. The gallery has built a reputation for introducing artists such as Isabelle Albuquerque, Devin B. Johnson, Adrian Ghenie, and Moffat Takadiwa to wider audiences, later supported by major institutional exhibitions and biennials. Nicodim regularly participates in international art fairs including Frieze, Art Basel, and The Armory Show, and maintains an active exhibition schedule across its three locations, reflecting a program invested in figuration, materiality, and voices from outside traditional Western art centers.
